scenarios.name: Fig. 3 probabilities
scenarios.assumptions:
Prior Pr(D) = 0.70 and edge probabilities from Fig. 3, read with the course semantics m1a-static-opportunity-1 (each step attempted once, independent). Effort costs are illustrative and unrelated to the probabilities.
Source: Poolsappasit, Dewri and Ray (2012), Dynamic security risk management using Bayesian attack graphs, IEEE TDSC 9(1), Fig. 3 (p.5) and §4.4. Reported: Pr(A) = 0.6060; Pr(C | A) = 0.81.
Transcription notes: The paper derives edge probabilities from CVSS scores (Eq. 4.1); they are not calibrated success rates. The course semantics reproduce the paper's Pr(A) = 0.6060 and Pr(C | A) = 0.81 because D is shared and A is a noisy-OR of B and C.

semantics: Conditions are persistent Boolean facts; there are no delete effects or negation.
AND requires all incoming inputs; OR requires at least one. Unlabelled joins use the per-scenario AND/OR choice.
An action is enabled when its inputs hold (or it is an approved entry action); executing it assumes success.
Each action executes at most once; efforts are nonnegative, additive, and shared actions are charged once.
Minimum effort is an exact search over closed active sets; limits yield an incomplete result, never a minimum or unreachability.
importDefaults: New imports: root and declared starting conditions true; root actions allowed as entries.
New imports: unlabelled joins default to OR; missing efforts default to 1; goal = reachable node of greatest minimum dependency depth.
rules.probabilitySemantics: m1a-static-opportunity-1: each action with probability p is attempted once when enabled and succeeds independently; initial facts with a prior hold independently; AND/OR deterministic; evidence conditions the final closure; never combined with effort.
